articles.title: How /settings ate the JSON config (and what stayed in code)
articles.focus: A walk through the new Appearance, Input, Behavior, Providers, MCP, and Advanced tabs, why the wizard landing page and mode-specific providers were reshaped, how the in-app agents.config.json editor edits strings with the cursor inside the quotes and saves atomically, and what the NANOCODER_* env vars and the theme-aware StyledSelectInput fix look like in practice.

articles.title: Defending the context window in Nanocoder 1.30
articles.focus: A behind-the-scenes tour of the tail-weighted bash truncation, oversized-result bounding that preserves the actionable tail, the string_replace and diff_edit edits now bounded around the changed region, git_diff capped at a 20-entry diffstat, list_directory dropping sizes by default, write_file stopping from echoing the file back, read_file returning a preview before demanding a ranged read, and dropping toLocaleString separators in model-facing strings.

articles.title: VS Code in 1.30: queued work, real cancel, CLI you can find
articles.focus: How the new chat panel surfaces tool calls as a queued, running, done checklist with plain English labels and live Open Diff buttons, why Escape and the nanocoder.cancel command now reliably tear down the in-flight request and clear pending approvals, how session renaming rides on a new renameSession ACP extMethod, and what changed in CLI discovery so Windows, NVM, Volta, fnm, pnpm, and bun users can actually start the extension.
